audio: Selected recordings; human clips placed at logged runtime offsets, including both N4 turns. Human/model channels separately peak-normalized to 0.85 and encoded as stereo MP3. No timing changes.
demoSelection: Four selected systems per scenario. Names are shown only for examples passing the displayed metric; unsuccessful and ineligible examples are anonymized independently per metric. The full results table includes all five evaluated systems.
waveforms: 360 peak-amplitude bins per original track; display only, not the evaluation speech detector.
results: Counts regrouped by each scenario's T addressing condition; shared with the manuscript table renderer.
